subject: Mr. Lee
text: The recommended level to fight Mr. Lee is Level 15.

evidence.quote:
BOSS Name:          Mr. Lee
Recommended Level:  15

subject: Mr. Lee
text: Defeating Mr. Lee yields 10 GP, 11 EXP, and the Magic Book of Sleep.

evidence.quote:
GP:                 10
EXP gained:         11
Attacks:            Bats
Best Equipment:     Chain, Cure Spell
Items Gained:       Magic Book of Sleep

subject: Kett's House
text: From outside Kett's, travel to Wendel by going east three times, south, west, cutting the vines, south, west, north, crossing the river with the Chain Flail, south, east, south twice, east, and north twice.

evidence.quote:
From outside Kett's, go east three times, south, west, cut
down the vines, and then go south. Then go west, north, and use the
Chain Flail to go across the river. Then go south, east, south twice,
east, and then north twice.

subject: Julius
text: The man who helped in the cave reveals himself to be Julius, abducting the Girl and taking her away in an airship.

evidence.quote:
The man who helped you turns into Julius. He then takes the Girl and runs
outside....Cibba tells you that Julius took the Girl
away in the airship.

subject: Cibba
text: After Julius zaps the hero outside town, Cibba gives the hero the Heal magic spell in the temple.

evidence.quote:
When you wake up, you will find yourself
in the temple with Cibba. Cibba tells you that Julius took the Girl
away in the airship. He then gives you the magic spell Heal.

subject: Wendel
text: From outside Wendel, go west, south, west, chop the tree above the sand with the Battle Axe, go west twice, and enter the cave.

evidence.quote:
From outside Wendel, go west, south, and west. Now cut down the tree to
the west that is directly above the sand with your Battle Axe. Then go
west twice, and into the cave.

subject: Oil
text: To buy Oil for 500 gold for the trolley tracks, leave Dwarf Cave, go north one screen, cross the stream with the Chain, head south twice, east, and enter the Item shop.

evidence.quote:
One will
tell you that you need to buy some Oil for the trolley tracks....Exit the Dwarf Cave and go north one screen. Then, use the Chain to go
across the stream. Then go south twice, east, and into the Item shop.
Buy an Oil for 500 gold, and exit the store.

subject: Dwarf Cave
text: To reach the Silver Mine from the Oil shop, go north, cross the stream with the Chain, go north twice, chop the trees with the Battle Axe across two screens, and head west into the mine.

evidence.quote:
Now go north a screen, use the Chain to get across the stream, and go
north twice. Now you need to equip the Battle Axe so you can chop down
the trees in the northwest corner of the screen. Now go north a screen
and chop some more trees....Now go west one screen, and into the Silver Mine.

subject: Mine Cart
text: Riding the mine cart requires using Oil on the cart and hitting the second and third switches with the Sickle to crash into the rock pile.

evidence.quote:
Use the Oil on the cart and make sure you have your Sickle
equipped. You need the Sickle to change the tracks your cart is riding
on by hitting the second and third switch. Jump into the mine cart and
you will travel west two screens. Don't hit this switch. Now be patient
until you reach the next switch as the mine cart goes through two
screens west, one south, and one east. The switch you need to hit is
near the beginning of the screen and it is north of the tracks. After
hitting this switch you will travel south one screen where you have to
hit another switch on the east side of the tracks. Now the track will
lead to a pile of rocks, which your cart will hit. You are knocked down
into the mineshaft.

subject: Watts
text: At the bottom of the mineshaft on B-Floor 2, Watts joins the group and offers items for sale, including X-Cure.

evidence.quote:
* B-Floor 2 * At the bottom of the mineshaft you will meet Watts. He
will join your group and help you look for Silver. If you are low on
supplies, ASK Watts and he'll let you buy some of the Items he is
carrying. Watts also sells X-Cure, which can not be bought until later
on in the game.

subject: Silver Mine B-Floor 2
text: On B-Floor 2, head north, break the northern boulder with a Mattock, proceed east through the door, break the east wall with a Mattock, break a pot, stand on the odd tile, slide east across the ice, and descend the stairs.

evidence.quote:
From here, go north and use a Mattock to break the
boulder at the north portion of the screen. Then go east and through
the door....Now use a Mattock on the east wall, and
then go through the hole. Use a Mattock on the pot and stand on the odd
tile. Now slide east on the ice, and then go down the stairs.

subject: Megapede
text: The recommended level to fight Megapede is Level 19.

evidence.quote:
BOSS Name:          Megapede
Recommended Level:  19

subject: Megapede
text: Defeating Megapede yields 161 GP, 48 EXP, and a treasure chest containing Silver.

evidence.quote:
GP:                 161
EXP gained:         48
Attacks:            None
Best Equipment:     Chain, Cure Spell
Items Gained:       Silver...Once it is defeated, open the treasure chest for
the Silver.

subject: Megapede
text: Megapede moves in a figure 8 motion and must be struck in the head; it explodes upon defeat so keep at least 20 HP remaining.

evidence.quote:
The Megapede will come out of one of the four holes. It
travels in a normal or sideways figure 8 motion. Wait for him at a
hole, and then hit it in the head. The Megapede will not receive any
damage if you hit him on the body. Make sure you have at least 20 HP
when you defeat it, because it will explode and deal your character a
fair amount of damage.

subject: Gaia's Cave
text: In Gaia's Cave, walk south between the two statues to close the door, step back up partway until it opens, and quickly pass south through the open door to the southeast stairs.

evidence.quote:
Go west, south, and then walk south between two statues. Once you walk
between the statues the door will shut. So go back up partway between
the statues and as soon as the door opens, go back south and through
the door. Then go up the stairs in the southeast corner of the room.

subject: Bogard
text: Outside Gaia's Cave, Bogard joins the party and reveals that the Airship is refueling at the lake to the north.

evidence.quote:
Once you are outside the cave Bogard will join your group. He tells you
that the Airship it refueling at the lake to the north.

subject: Refueling Lake Item Shop
text: The Item Shop near Refueling Lake sells the Silver Helmet, a set of Keys, and a set of Mattocks.

evidence.quote:
Now go north and into the Item Shop. Buy the Silver Helmet, a set of Keys,
and a set of Mattocks.

subject: Refueling Lake
text: From the Item Shop, reach the Airship by going east twice, north, east through trees, crossing the stream with the Chain Flail at max attack bar, north, east, Chain Flail, west, down the vine, west, Chain Flail across water, south, west, north twice, and climbing the chain.

evidence.quote:
After exiting the shop, go east twice, north,
east through the trees to the next screen. Then wait until you attack
bar is at the Max and use the Chain Flail to cross the stream. Then go
north, east, use the Chain Flail, and then west. Then go down the vine
and west. Use the Chain Flail to go across the water and then go south.
Now go west and north twice. Then climb the chain and go up into the
Airship

subject: Airship B-Floor 3
text: On B-Floor 3 of the Airship, stepping onto the odd tile in the northeast corner and then the odd tile in the northwest corner causes stairs to appear in the southeast corner.

evidence.quote:
* B-Floor 3 * Now go west a screen, and then south a screen. Walk onto
the odd tile in the northeast corner of the screen and then stand on
the odd tile in the northwest corner. Stairs will appear in the
southeast corner. Now go down the stairs.

subject: Girl
text: After navigating through the Airship to the outside ladder, talking to the Girl at the second window rewards the player with the pendant.

evidence.quote:
Then go
south down the ladder to the next screen. Go east a screen and talk to
the Girl who is leaning out the second window. The Girl will give you
the pendant.

subject: Julius
text: Julius attacks the Airship bridge with magic, causing the hero to fall off the ship and into a town.

evidence.quote:
Just when the Hero accomplishes his goal, Julius finds the
Hero and the Girl. Julies attacks the bridge with his magic causing you
to fall off the airship and into a town.

subject: Amanda
text: Amanda nurses the hero back to health in Menos, steals the pendant, and departs town.

evidence.quote:
Amanda, a fellow gladiator and friend, brings you back to her house.
She then nurses you back to health, but before you regain
consciousness, she regretfully steals the pendant. Exit the house and
walk to the Weapon Shop....Second that Amanda left town... hmm, I wonder where she went?

subject: Mr. Lee
text: You can block Mr. Lee's bats with your shield, dodge his bats, and then strike at him.

evidence.quote: Luckily, you are able to block the bats with your shield....Dodge his bats and then strike at him.
